name: Pam Bogart

position: Consulting Technical Director / Customer Success Manager
about:
I thrive helping customers identify problems and discover real solutions. New product launches, new systems, mergers and acquisitions each create unique opportunities for exceptional solutions. 

Specialty:

• Sr. Project Manager experienced with resource management and the implementation of new systems such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Vantive, MFG/Pro, Solomon, AccPac, and several custom applications. 
• Recruited, hired and developed employees and contractors to create great teams. The perfect team being critical to any project where the members have collaborative working styles, balanced skills, and commitment to deliver.
• Experience managing teams responsible for development, business analysis, order management, fulfillment, licensing, purchasing, and finance. Created and executed against many strategic methodologies. Well rounded knowledge to enhance systems and build stronger teams equipped to solve business problems.
